assessments.reasoning: The retained Go 1.23.0 command help explicitly gives an applicable workspace replacement priority over conflicting module-file replacements. It identifies the workspace file in use as relevant to the rule.

challenge.method: Check whether precedence requires two modules to disagree, and whether an unrelated workspace replacement resolves that disagreement.
challenge.results: Conflict between modules is a documented use case. Precedence also covers a conflict with one module's replacement. The passage gives no basis to apply an unrelated replacement or an inactive workspace file.

limitations: The claim describes documented workspace precedence, without specifying which replacement applies to every path/version pattern or the outcome in single-module mode.
This verifies the Go 1.23.0 command documentation for workspace mode with an applicable replacement. It makes no comprehensive claim about pattern matching or single-module mode.
